headline: Testy jater
Vysvětleno
frames.scene: The same woman before work holds a liver-test handout with a friendly printed liver illustration and a simple report table.
frames.jtbd: I have liver blood-test results and want a plain-language explanation and questions to ask my doctor.
frames.visualLimit: Fictional scene. Printed liver is an illustrative handout, not a diagnostic image. No fabricated lab values or AI answer.

headline: Jatera v mysli
Co jíst?
frames.scene: A man photographs his sandwich and soup at an everyday cafe.
frames.jtbd: I have liver concerns and need help making sense of my ordinary meal.
frames.visualLimit: AI-generated fictional people and an illustrative situation; not a patient testimonial or a recorded app session.

headline: Méně alkoholu
Stále jsi
frames.scene: A woman at dinner with friends declines offered wine and holds sparkling water with lime.
frames.jtbd: I want a dated record of what I drink, including days without alcohol; not necessarily a sobriety streak.
frames.visualLimit: AI-generated fictional dinner; enlarged illustrative UI detail faithfully uses existing DrinkLogView input fields. Zero is an unsaved input, not a fabricated history or recovery claim.

headline: Zeptej se
Tvoje jaterní zdraví
frames.scene: A large first-session result interface connects a personal liver question with a useful question to keep; no lifestyle portrait.
frames.jtbd: I have a liver concern and want to understand what to ask or do next.
frames.visualLimit: Source-based first-session result concept. Context excerpt and suggested question come from the retained live start example, not an invented Coach conversation.

headline: Návštěva lékaře
Nesou tvoje otázky
frames.scene: A woman hands her prepared questions to her clinician and points to the paper; a large Doctor Brief editor shows what she can prepare in the app.
frames.jtbd: I do not want to leave my appointment having forgotten an important question.
frames.visualLimit: Fictional consultation, not clinician endorsement. A source-based editor fragment with example user questions; no automatic transfer from FirstSession or verified PDF export implied.

headline: Předchozí výsledky
Snadno najít
frames.scene: A prominent dated list of saved liver results sits over a secondary close view of paper reports; no trend chart or patient portrait.
frames.jtbd: I need to retrieve a previous liver result or question without searching through paperwork.
frames.visualLimit: Illustrative FirstHistory entries, not real patient results. Source task titles and user-authored example questions with dates; no lab values, unified Labs screen, or improvement trend.

headline: Špatná noc?
Poznamenejte si to
frames.scene: A moon symbol and a large dated Poor sleep entry over a quiet notebook-and-tea scene make a specific morning-after check-in recognizable without another tired portrait.
frames.jtbd: After a poor night I want to note what happened while it is fresh, so I can describe it later.
frames.visualLimit: Poor sleep is a supported self-reported symptom, not a liver diagnosis. Enlarged selected fields from the symptom form; 3/5 is an example personal rating.

headline: Zaznamenat
Léčivo
frames.scene: An unbranded medicine bottle and carton sit on a kitchen counter above a large dated medication-entry form; there is no repeated portrait.
frames.focus: Udržujte si detaily o užívání léčiv
frames.jtbd: I want to remember which medicine I took and on what date instead of relying on memory.
frames.visualLimit: Manual entry for an already-taken medicine. User example is deliberately not a drug recommendation; no scan, dose advice, schedule or interaction check promised.
